blocks.zh: Topic 1：病毒載體的分類框架與管控策略
blocks.en: Topic 1: Classification Framework and Control Strategy for Viral Vectors

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解相同的病毒載體在不同監管轄區（FDA、EMA、TGA）可能被分類為不同監管類別（起始物料、關鍵起始物料、藥物物質）的原因與影響
blocks.en: Understand why the same viral vector may be classified into different regulatory categories (starting material, critical starting material, drug substance) in different jurisdictions (FDA, EMA, TGA), and what the consequences are

blocks.zh: 熟悉主要監管指引文件清單，包括 FDA CMC 指引、EMA 指引與 PIC/S Annex 2A，掌握各文件適用範圍與實務價值
blocks.en: Become familiar with the main regulatory guidance documents, including the FDA CMC guidance, EMA guidelines, and PIC/S Annex 2A, and grasp the scope and practical value of each

blocks.zh: 掌握三類基因治療產品的分類原則（Figure 1.3-1），並能區分 FDA 與 EMA 在 ex vivo CAR-T 製造中對病毒載體的不同定位
blocks.en: Grasp the classification principles for the three types of gene therapy products (Figure 1.3-1), and be able to distinguish how the FDA and EMA each position the viral vector in ex vivo CAR-T manufacturing

blocks.zh: 瞭解 GMP 對藥物物質與起始物料的要求差異，以及 Quality Agreement（品質協議）在委外生產中的關鍵角色
blocks.en: Understand how GMP requirements differ for drug substances and starting materials, and the key role of the Quality Agreement in outsourced manufacturing

blocks.zh: 識別質體 DNA 的特殊管控挑戰：序列完整性、多質體系統風險，以及 CDMO 多產品設施中交叉污染的真實風險
blocks.en: Recognize the special control challenges of plasmid DNA: sequence integrity, the risks of multi-plasmid systems, and the real risk of cross-contamination in multi-product CDMO facilities

blocks.zh: Q 1.1 — Classification Framework for Plasmids and Viral Vectors Q 1.1 — 質體與病毒載體分類架構
blocks.en: Q 1.1 - Classification Framework for Plasmids and Viral Vectors

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Starting Material（起始物料）：製程中所使用的原料，在進一步加工後成為藥物物質或最終產品的一部分，本身不直接給予患者。
blocks.en: Starting Material: a raw material used in the process that, after further processing, becomes part of the drug substance or final product; it is not administered to the patient directly.

blocks.zh: Critical Starting Material（關鍵起始物料）：起始物料中，因其對最終產品安全性、有效性或品質有重大影響，而被界定為需要加強管控的特殊類別。
blocks.en: Critical Starting Material: a special category of starting material that is defined as requiring enhanced control because it has a significant impact on the safety, efficacy, or quality of the final product.

blocks.zh: Drug Substance / Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient（藥物物質 / 活性醫藥成分）：即直接構成藥物活性部分的物質，必須符合最高等級 GMP 要求，並作為獨立的 CMC 申報章節提交。
blocks.en: Drug Substance / Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient: the substance that directly constitutes the active part of the medicinal product; it must meet the highest level of GMP requirements and is submitted as a separate CMC section in the filing.

blocks.zh: In vivo gene therapy（活體基因治療）：將病毒載體直接注射至患者體內，載體本身即為藥物物質。
blocks.en: In vivo gene therapy: the viral vector is injected directly into the patient's body, and the vector itself is the drug substance.

blocks.zh: Ex vivo genetic modification（體外基因修飾）：先在體外用病毒載體修飾患者細胞，再將修飾後的細胞回輸患者。此情境下，FDA 視載體為藥物物質；EMA 視之為關鍵起始物料。
blocks.en: Ex vivo genetic modification: the patient's cells are first modified outside the body with a viral vector, and the modified cells are then infused back into the patient. In this scenario, the FDA regards the vector as a drug substance, while the EMA regards it as a critical starting material.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一間米其林餐廳。同樣的松露（病毒載體），若直接擺盤上桌供客人食用，它就是「主菜」（藥物物質，須符合最嚴格的食品安全規範）；但若廚師先用松露來烹調醬汁，再將醬汁淋在主菜上——松露就只是「食材」（起始物料）。
blocks.en: Imagine a Michelin-starred restaurant. Take the same truffle (the viral vector). If it is plated and served directly to the guest, it is the "main dish" (the drug substance, subject to the strictest food safety rules). But if the chef first uses the truffle to cook a sauce that is then poured over the main dish, the truffle is only an "ingredient" (a starting material).

blocks.zh: 更麻煩的是：同一顆松露，在巴黎（EU）的廚房裡算「特級食材」（關鍵起始物料），但在紐約（FDA）的廚房裡直接算「主菜」（藥物物質）。廚師（CDMO）必須根據餐廳所在城市的衛生法規，決定這顆松露需要哪些處理程序和文件。
blocks.en: What makes it more troublesome is that the very same truffle counts as a "premium ingredient" (critical starting material) in a kitchen in Paris (EU), but counts directly as the "main dish" (drug substance) in a kitchen in New York (FDA). The chef (the CDMO) must decide which handling procedures and documentation this truffle needs according to the hygiene regulations of the city where the restaurant is located.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — CDMO 合規挑戰
blocks.en: Key Notes: Compliance Challenges for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，同一個病毒載體製程，服務不同客戶時可能面對完全不同的法規要求：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the same viral vector process may face completely different regulatory requirements when serving different clients:

blocks.zh: 美國客戶：載體必須按 Drug Substance GMP 生產，需要完整的批次記錄、藥物物質規格書與 DS 章節 IND 申報
blocks.en: US clients: the vector must be manufactured under Drug Substance GMP, which requires complete batch records, a drug substance specification, and a DS section in the IND filing

blocks.zh: 歐盟客戶：載體視為關鍵起始物料，GMP 要求相對寬鬆，但 ATMP 製造商需透過 Quality Agreement 稽核 CDMO 是否落實適當管控
blocks.en: EU clients: the vector is regarded as a critical starting material and the GMP requirements are relatively less stringent, but the ATMP manufacturer must audit the CDMO through the Quality Agreement to confirm that appropriate controls are implemented

blocks.zh: 澳洲客戶：in vivo 與 ex vivo 用途的同一載體，適用完全不同的法規框架
blocks.en: Australian clients: the same vector used in vivo versus ex vivo falls under completely different regulatory frameworks

blocks.zh: 實務建議：接案前必須確認客戶所有目標市場的法規要求，以「最嚴格」的那個市場作為生產標準基準線，避免因分類錯誤導致臨床試驗延遲或被要求重製。
blocks.en: Practical advice: before accepting a project, confirm the regulatory requirements of all of the client's target markets, and use the "strictest" market as the baseline manufacturing standard, to avoid clinical trial delays or being required to remanufacture because of a misclassification.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 正在為某美國客戶生產用於 CAR-T 療法的慢病毒載體（lentiviral vector），請問該載體在 FDA 法規框架下應被視為什麼？需要達到什麼等級的 GMP？
blocks.en: A CDMO is manufacturing a lentiviral vector for a US client for use in a CAR-T therapy. How should this vector be regarded under the FDA regulatory framework? What level of GMP is required?

blocks.zh: 若同一客戶計劃同時在美國與歐盟進行臨床試驗，CDMO 應採取什麼策略來同時滿足 FDA 與 EMA 的要求？
blocks.en: If the same client plans to run clinical trials in the US and the EU at the same time, what strategy should the CDMO adopt to meet both FDA and EMA requirements?

blocks.zh: 澳洲 TGA 對「相同病毒載體用於不同用途」有不同分類，這對 CDMO 的廠務管理有什麼具體影響？
blocks.en: The Australian TGA classifies "the same viral vector used for different purposes" differently. What specific impact does this have on the CDMO's site operations and management?

blocks.zh: Q 1.2 — Available Regulatory Guidance Q 1.2 — 現有法規指引
blocks.en: Q 1.2 - Available Regulatory Guidance

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 主要法規文件一覽
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Overview of the Main Regulatory Documents

blocks.zh: 以下六份文件是目前質體與病毒載體分類的主要法規依據，請務必熟悉其適用範圍：
blocks.en: The following six documents are the main regulatory basis for the classification of plasmids and viral vectors, and you should be familiar with the scope of each:

blocks.zh: FDA Gene Therapy CMC IND Guidance：美國 IND 申請中 CMC 章節的核心依據，適用於臨床試驗階段，主要針對基因治療藥物物質的生產要求
blocks.en: FDA Gene Therapy CMC IND Guidance: the core reference for the CMC section of a US IND application; it applies to the clinical trial stage and mainly addresses manufacturing requirements for gene therapy drug substances

blocks.zh: FDA CAR-T Guidance：專針對 CAR-T 細胞產品，明確病毒載體作為 DS 的要求
blocks.en: FDA CAR-T Guidance: specific to CAR-T cell products; it makes explicit the requirements for the viral vector as a DS

blocks.zh: FDA Genome Editing Guidance：擴展至基因組編輯（如 CRISPR）產品
blocks.en: FDA Genome Editing Guidance: extends to genome editing (such as CRISPR) products

blocks.zh: EMA/CAT/80183/2014：EMA 針對基因治療藥品品質、非臨床與臨床的全面指引，適用於上市許可申請（MAA）
blocks.en: EMA/CAT/80183/2014: the EMA's comprehensive guideline on the quality, non-clinical, and clinical aspects of gene therapy medicinal products; it applies to marketing authorization applications (MAA)

blocks.zh: EMA/CAT/GTWP/671639/2008：針對含基因修飾細胞藥品，是 CAR-T 類產品的 EMA 主要依據
blocks.en: EMA/CAT/GTWP/671639/2008: addresses medicinal products containing genetically modified cells and is the EMA's main reference for CAR-T type products

blocks.zh: EMA Q&A EMA/246400/2021：專門解答 ATMP 起始物料 GMP 原則，Question 5 的風險因素分析是實務指引的核心
blocks.en: EMA Q&A EMA/246400/2021: dedicated to answering questions on the GMP principles for ATMP starting materials; the risk factor analysis in Question 5 is the core of the practical guidance

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — PIC/S Annex 2A：最實用的多轄區工具
blocks.en: Key Point: PIC/S Annex 2A, the Most Practical Multi-Jurisdiction Tool

blocks.zh: 在眾多文件中，PIC/S Annex 2A（Sections 5.20–5.29）具有特殊的實務價值，原因如下：
blocks.en: Among the many documents, PIC/S Annex 2A (Sections 5.20–5.29) has special practical value, for the following reasons:

blocks.zh: 多轄區認可：PIC/S 成員包括 FDA、EMA、TGA、台灣 TFDA、日本 PMDA 等50多個監管機構。採用 PIC/S Annex 2A 框架制定的分類策略，較能被多個市場同時接受
blocks.en: Recognition across multiple jurisdictions: PIC/S members include more than 50 regulatory authorities such as the FDA, EMA, TGA, Taiwan TFDA, and Japan PMDA. A classification strategy built on the PIC/S Annex 2A framework is more likely to be accepted in several markets at once

blocks.zh: 系統化分類條款：Sections 5.20–5.29 提供了可直接用於判斷材料分類的系統性條款，彌補了 FDA 與 EMA 指引在「起始物料」分類上的模糊地帶
blocks.en: Systematic classification provisions: Sections 5.20–5.29 provide systematic provisions that can be used directly to determine material classification, filling the gap left by the FDA and EMA guidance in the classification of "starting materials"

blocks.zh: EMA Q&A 的基礎：EMA Q&A (EMA/246400/2021) 即以 PIC/S Annex 2A 為基礎撰寫，掌握前者有助於深入理解後者
blocks.en: Basis of the EMA Q&A: the EMA Q&A (EMA/246400/2021) was written on the basis of PIC/S Annex 2A, so mastering the former helps in understanding the latter

blocks.zh: Phase-appropriate 精神：業界共識（雖尚未明文規定）認為 PIC/S Annex 2A 的原則可按臨床階段遞進式應用
blocks.en: Phase-appropriate spirit: industry consensus (although not yet explicitly stated in writing) holds that the principles of PIC/S Annex 2A can be applied progressively according to the clinical phase

blocks.zh: 實務建議：在制定 CDMO 的病毒載體或質體分類 SOP 時，以 PIC/S Annex 2A Sections 5.20–5.29 作為分類框架主軸，再依客戶市場疊加 FDA 或 EMA 的特定要求。
blocks.en: Practical advice: when drafting a CDMO's SOP for classifying viral vectors or plasmids, use PIC/S Annex 2A Sections 5.20–5.29 as the backbone of the classification framework, and then layer on the specific FDA or EMA requirements according to the client's market.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 法規文件的層級關係
blocks.en: Analogy: The Hierarchy of Regulatory Documents

blocks.zh: 這些法規文件就像一套「交通法規體系」：
blocks.en: These regulatory documents are like a "traffic law system":

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 2A = 國際道路交通公約（多國共同遵守的基本規則）
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 2A = the international road traffic convention (basic rules that many countries follow in common)

blocks.zh: FDA Gene Therapy CMC Guidance = 美國特定州的細部行車規範（更嚴格、更明確）
blocks.en: FDA Gene Therapy CMC Guidance = detailed driving rules of a particular US state (stricter and more explicit)

blocks.zh: EMA 指引 = 歐盟各國的行車規範（有共同框架但各國仍有細節差異）
blocks.en: EMA guidelines = driving rules of the EU member states (a common framework, but with detail differences between countries)

blocks.zh: EMA Q&A = 歐盟交通執法機關的常見問題解答（解釋如何執行規範）
blocks.en: EMA Q&A = the FAQ of the EU traffic enforcement authority (explaining how the rules are applied)

blocks.zh: 在多國市場同時開發的產品，必須設計一套「滿足最嚴格條件」的行駛策略，才能在各國道路上合法通行。
blocks.en: A product developed for several national markets at once must have a driving strategy designed to "satisfy the strictest conditions" in order to travel legally on the roads of every country.

blocks.zh: FDA CMC Gene Therapy IND Guidance 與 EMA/CAT/80183/2014 在適用範圍上有什麼主要差異（臨床 vs 上市）？這對 CDMO 接受早期臨床案件有什麼影響？
blocks.en: What are the main differences in scope between the FDA CMC Gene Therapy IND Guidance and EMA/CAT/80183/2014 (clinical vs. marketing)? How does this affect a CDMO accepting early-phase clinical projects?

blocks.zh: EMA Q&A (EMA/246400/2021) 的 Question 5 列出了哪些風險評估因素？這些因素如何影響 CDMO 對起始物料的管控設計？
blocks.en: Which risk assessment factors are listed in Question 5 of the EMA Q&A (EMA/246400/2021)? How do these factors influence the CDMO's design of controls for starting materials?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PIC/S Annex 2A 被認為是「最實用的多轄區工具」？請說明其與 FDA 及 EMA 指引的互補關係。
blocks.en: Why is PIC/S Annex 2A regarded as the "most practical multi-jurisdiction tool"? Explain how it complements the FDA and EMA guidance.

blocks.zh: Q 1.3 — Classification Principles from Regulatory Guidance Q 1.3 — 法規指引之分類原則
blocks.en: Q 1.3 - Classification Principles from Regulatory Guidance

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 三種基因治療產品類型
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Three Types of Gene Therapy Products

blocks.zh: PtC-11 Figure 1.3-1 將基因治療產品分為三大類型，每種類型的材料分類邏輯完全不同：
blocks.en: PtC-11 Figure 1.3-1 divides gene therapy products into three types, and the logic for classifying materials is completely different for each:

blocks.zh: Type 1 — In vivo 直接注射 mRNA/DNA：mRNA 或裸 DNA 本身即為藥物物質（DS），質體 DNA 和細菌 Master Cell Bank（MCB）為起始物料。典型例子：mRNA 疫苗、脂質奈米顆粒包封的 DNA 治療
blocks.en: Type 1 - In vivo direct injection of mRNA/DNA: the mRNA or naked DNA itself is the drug substance (DS), and the plasmid DNA and the bacterial Master Cell Bank (MCB) are starting materials. Typical examples: mRNA vaccines, lipid nanoparticle-encapsulated DNA therapies

blocks.zh: Type 2 — In vivo 病毒載體基因治療：AAV 等病毒載體為 DS，用於生產載體的多個質體及 Master Virus Seed Stock 為起始物料。典型例子：Luxturna（視網膜萎縮症）、Zolgensma（脊髓肌肉萎縮症）
blocks.en: Type 2 - In vivo viral vector gene therapy: a viral vector such as AAV is the DS, and the plasmids used to produce the vector and the Master Virus Seed Stock are starting materials. Typical examples: Luxturna (retinal dystrophy), Zolgensma (spinal muscular atrophy)

blocks.zh: Type 3 — Ex vivo 細胞修飾（CAR-T 等）：這是最複雜的類型，FDA 視慢病毒載體 AND 修飾後 T 細胞均為 DS；EMA 僅視修飾後 T 細胞為 DS，慢病毒載體降格為關鍵起始物料
blocks.en: Type 3 - Ex vivo cell modification (CAR-T, etc.): this is the most complex type. The FDA regards both the lentiviral vector AND the modified T cells as DS; the EMA regards only the modified T cells as the DS, and the lentiviral vector is downgraded to a critical starting material

blocks.zh: 重要術語：Master Virus Seed Stock（主病毒種子庫）是用於批量生產病毒載體的參考批次，建立並確認後即作為所有後續生產批次的溯源依據，一旦耗盡必須重新確認新的種子庫。
blocks.en: Key term: the Master Virus Seed Stock is the reference batch used for large-scale production of the viral vector. Once established and confirmed, it serves as the traceability basis for all subsequent production batches, and when it is exhausted a new seed stock must be re-established and confirmed.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — FDA 與 EMA 的命名分歧
blocks.en: Analogy: The FDA and EMA Naming Divergence

blocks.zh: FDA 與 EMA 的分類差異，就像英美兩國對同一道食材的不同稱呼：
blocks.en: The classification difference between the FDA and EMA is like the US and the UK using different names for the same ingredient:

blocks.zh: FDA 稱慢病毒載體（用於 CAR-T 生產）為「主菜（Drug Substance）」，要求高規格廚房（CGMP）和獨立的菜單頁（DS 申報章節）
blocks.en: The FDA calls the lentiviral vector (used in CAR-T production) the "main dish (Drug Substance)", requiring a high-specification kitchen (CGMP) and a separate menu page (the DS filing section)

blocks.zh: EMA 稱同樣的慢病毒載體為「高級食材（Critical Starting Material）」，廚房要求相對寬鬆，但客戶（ATMP 製造商）要負責確認供應商廚房符合品質要求
blocks.en: The EMA calls the same lentiviral vector a "premium ingredient (Critical Starting Material)", with relatively looser kitchen requirements, but the client (the ATMP manufacturer) is responsible for confirming that the supplier's kitchen meets the quality requirements

blocks.zh: 兩者都重視食品安全，只是監管途徑不同。關鍵在於：如果你的餐廳（CDMO）同時接待美國和歐洲的客人，就必須以美國的標準來處理這份食材，因為美國標準更高——這樣自然也能滿足歐洲的要求。
blocks.en: Both care about food safety; the regulatory route is simply different. The key point is this: if your restaurant (the CDMO) serves both American and European guests, you must handle this ingredient to the American standard, because the American standard is higher, and that will naturally also satisfy the European requirements.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 同時服務美國與歐盟客戶的 CDMO 策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: A CDMO Strategy for Serving Both US and EU Clients

blocks.zh: 原則：永遠將病毒載體視為藥物物質（Drug Substance）來製造。
blocks.en: Principle: always manufacture the viral vector as a Drug Substance.

blocks.zh: 具體做法：
blocks.en: In practice:

blocks.zh: 按 FDA CGMP（21 CFR Parts 210/211）規格建立並維護所有生產記錄
blocks.en: Establish and maintain all production records to FDA CGMP (21 CFR Parts 210/211) specifications

blocks.zh: 為每個載體建立獨立的藥物物質規格書（DS Specification），包含 identity、purity、strength、quality 的完整測試清單
blocks.en: Establish a separate drug substance specification (DS Specification) for each vector, with a complete test list covering identity, purity, strength, and quality

blocks.zh: 在 IND 申請中提交獨立的 DS CMC 章節（符合 FDA 要求）
blocks.en: Submit a separate DS CMC section in the IND application (to meet FDA requirements)

blocks.zh: 同一套文件將自動滿足 EMA 對「關鍵起始物料」的要求（EMA 要求僅為 FDA 要求的子集）
blocks.en: The same set of documents will automatically satisfy the EMA requirements for a "critical starting material" (the EMA requirements are only a subset of the FDA requirements)

blocks.zh: 儘早建立 Master Virus Seed Stock 和 Master Cell Bank，以符合歐盟日益嚴格的早期臨床要求
blocks.en: Establish the Master Virus Seed Stock and Master Cell Bank early, to meet the increasingly strict EU expectations for early-phase clinical trials

blocks.zh: 這個策略節省的不只是合規成本，更重要的是避免了因重新製造種子庫而導致的臨床試驗延遲（可能耗時 6–18 個月）。
blocks.en: This strategy saves not only compliance cost; more importantly, it avoids the clinical trial delay caused by having to remanufacture a seed stock (which can take 6–18 months).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — EMA 的「責任轉移」邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: The EMA's "Transfer of Responsibility" Logic

blocks.zh: EMA 的設計邏輯值得深入理解：由於歐盟法規目前不要求對起始物料製造商（如 CDMO）進行定期官方稽核或頒發 GMP 認證，因此監管機關將這個責任轉移給 ATMP 製造商（即 CDMO 的客戶）：
blocks.en: The logic behind the EMA's design is worth understanding in depth: because EU regulations currently do not require periodic official inspections of, or GMP certification for, starting material manufacturers (such as CDMOs), the regulator transfers this responsibility to the ATMP manufacturer (that is, the CDMO's client):

blocks.zh: 客戶（持有許可證的 ATMP 製造商）必須對 CDMO 進行供應商資格審核
blocks.en: The client (the licensed ATMP manufacturer) must perform supplier qualification audits on the CDMO

blocks.zh: 客戶必須透過 Quality Agreement 界定雙方責任
blocks.en: The client must define the responsibilities of both parties through a Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: 客戶的稽核結果和起始物料品質，將在 CTA（臨床試驗申請）和 GMP 稽查中被審查
blocks.en: The client's audit results and the quality of the starting material will be reviewed in the CTA (clinical trial application) and in GMP inspections

blocks.zh: 這表示：即使 CDMO 自認 GMP 合規，若客戶未建立適當的供應商管理程序，兩者都可能在 EMA 稽查中被標記為缺失。
blocks.en: This means that even if the CDMO considers itself GMP compliant, if the client has not established an appropriate supplier management procedure, both may be cited with a deficiency in an EMA inspection.

blocks.zh: 比較 Type 2（in vivo AAV 基因治療）和 Type 3（ex vivo CAR-T）的分類框架，說明質體 DNA 在兩種情境中的不同角色。
blocks.en: Compare the classification frameworks for Type 2 (in vivo AAV gene therapy) and Type 3 (ex vivo CAR-T), and explain the different roles of plasmid DNA in the two scenarios.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PtC-11 建議應「儘早建立 Master Virus Seed Stock」？這對早期臨床（Phase I）的 CDMO 有什麼實務影響？
blocks.en: Why does PtC-11 recommend establishing the Master Virus Seed Stock "as early as possible"? What are the practical implications for a CDMO supporting early clinical (Phase I) projects?

blocks.zh: EMA Q&A 中說「非所有 Part IV GMP 要求均適用於起始物料」，請列舉至少三項你認為仍應適用於病毒載體起始物料的 Part IV GMP 要求，並說明理由。
blocks.en: The EMA Q&A states that "not all Part IV GMP requirements apply to starting materials". List at least three Part IV GMP requirements that you think should still apply to viral vector starting materials, and explain why.

blocks.zh: Q 1.4 — GMP and Regulatory Requirements for Vectors as Drug Substances and Starting Materials Q 1.4 — 載體作為原料藥與起始物料之 GMP 與法規要求
blocks.en: Q 1.4 - GMP and Regulatory Requirements for Vectors as Drug Substances and Starting Materials

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — EMA Q&A Question 5 風險分析七大因素
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Seven Factors of the EMA Q&A Question 5 Risk Analysis

blocks.zh: EMA Q&A 第 5 問要求製造商針對起始物料製造進行風險評估，涵蓋以下七大面向：
blocks.en: Question 5 of the EMA Q&A requires the manufacturer to perform a risk assessment of starting material manufacture, covering the following seven areas:

blocks.zh: 交叉污染（Cross-contamination）：與其他載體或基因物質的交叉污染，多產品設施尤需嚴控
blocks.en: Cross-contamination: cross-contamination with other vectors or genetic material; tight control is especially needed in multi-product facilities

blocks.zh: 外源性因子（Adventitious agents）：包括 TSE（如牛海綿狀腦病 BSE、庫賈氏症 CJD）和病毒污染（包括形成複製能力病毒 RCV 的風險）
blocks.en: Adventitious agents: including TSE (such as bovine spongiform encephalopathy BSE and Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease CJD) and viral contamination (including the risk of forming replication-competent virus, RCV)

blocks.zh: 微生物管控（Microbiological controls）：無菌性、黴漿菌、內毒素的測試與管控
blocks.en: Microbiological controls: testing and control of sterility, mycoplasma, and endotoxin

blocks.zh: 雜質（Impurities）：來自原料（如抗生素殘留）、製程（如轉染增強劑）或攜帶進入的雜質（如殘留質體）
blocks.en: Impurities: impurities originating from raw materials (such as antibiotic residues), the process (such as transfection enhancers), or carry-over (such as residual plasmid)

blocks.zh: 環境管控（Environmental controls）：潔淨室等級、人員管控、製程環境監測
blocks.en: Environmental controls: cleanroom classification, personnel control, and process environmental monitoring

blocks.zh: 儲存與運輸（Storage and transportation）：包括供應鏈複雜度，冷鏈管理尤為關鍵
blocks.en: Storage and transportation: including supply chain complexity, where cold chain management is especially critical

blocks.zh: 穩定性（Stability）：起始物料的穩定性數據支持有效期設定
blocks.en: Stability: stability data for the starting material that support the setting of the shelf life

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 外源性因子：無法完全消除的風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Adventitious Agents, a Risk That Cannot Be Completely Eliminated

blocks.zh: 病毒載體製程面臨的最獨特挑戰是：外源性病毒風險（adventitious agents）無法被完全消除。
blocks.en: The most distinctive challenge of viral vector processes is that the risk of adventitious viruses (adventitious agents) cannot be completely eliminated.

blocks.zh: 原因如下：
blocks.en: The reasons are as follows:

blocks.zh: 病毒載體本身就是生物性大分子，無法採用終端滅菌（terminal sterilization）——高溫或輻射會破壞載體功能
blocks.en: A viral vector is itself a biological macromolecule and cannot be terminally sterilized, because heat or radiation would destroy the vector's function

blocks.zh: 製程中常用的動物來源原料（牛血清白蛋白、人類白蛋白）可能攜帶潛在病毒或 TSE 病原
blocks.en: Animal-derived raw materials commonly used in the process (bovine serum albumin, human albumin) may carry latent viruses or TSE agents

blocks.zh: Parvovirus（細小病毒）等小型病毒對常見的病毒清除步驟（如奈米過濾）具有高度抗性
blocks.en: Small viruses such as parvovirus are highly resistant to common viral clearance steps (such as nanofiltration)

blocks.zh: 病毒重組可能在生產過程中產生 Replication-Competent Virus（RCV，具複製能力病毒），這是基因治療的重大安全風險
blocks.en: Viral recombination may generate Replication-Competent Virus (RCV) during production, which is a major safety risk for gene therapy

blocks.zh: 因此，外源性因子管控策略（Adventitious Agent Control Strategy）必須採取多層次防禦：原料篩選 → 供應商資格確認 → 製程內測試 → 最終產品測試。任何單一層次的失敗都可能造成嚴重的患者安全問題。
blocks.en: The adventitious agent control strategy must therefore use a multi-layered defense: raw material screening → supplier qualification → in-process testing → final product testing. The failure of any single layer can lead to a serious patient safety problem.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — Quality Agreement 委外生產必備要素
blocks.en: Practical Application: Essential Elements of a Quality Agreement for Outsourced Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 為 ATMP 製造商生產病毒載體時，Quality Agreement（品質協議）是法規要求與商業關係的核心文件。以下是必須涵蓋的關鍵條款：
blocks.en: When a CDMO manufactures a viral vector for an ATMP manufacturer, the Quality Agreement is the core document linking the regulatory requirements and the commercial relationship. The key clauses that must be covered are as follows:

blocks.zh: 責任分工：明確界定誰負責原料采購、批次放行、異常調查、變更管控、穩定性研究
blocks.en: Division of responsibilities: clearly define who is responsible for raw material procurement, batch release, deviation investigation, change control, and stability studies

blocks.zh: 文件提供義務：CDMO 必須提供 IND CMC 章節所需的所有批次記錄、測試結果、設備確認報告
blocks.en: Documentation obligations: the CDMO must provide all batch records, test results, and equipment qualification reports required for the IND CMC section

blocks.zh: 外源性因子管控：明確外源性因子測試項目、方法、結果判定標準與不合格品處理流程
blocks.en: Adventitious agent control: clearly specify the adventitious agent test items, methods, result acceptance criteria, and the procedure for handling non-conforming product

blocks.zh: 交叉污染防控：CDMO 的清潔驗證、換產程序必須對客戶開放稽核
blocks.en: Cross-contamination prevention and control: the CDMO's cleaning validation and changeover procedures must be open to audit by the client

blocks.zh: 變更通知：CDMO 任何影響產品品質的製程或原料變更，必須在實施前通知客戶（通知期通常為 90 天以上）
blocks.en: Change notification: any process or raw material change by the CDMO that affects product quality must be notified to the client before implementation (the notice period is typically 90 days or more)

blocks.zh: 稽核權：客戶有權對 CDMO 進行定期 GMP 稽核（通常每年一次）
blocks.en: Right to audit: the client has the right to perform periodic GMP audits of the CDMO (usually once a year)

blocks.zh: 多國法規合規聲明：CDMO 應聲明其製程符合客戶所列目標市場的監管要求
blocks.en: Multi-jurisdiction compliance statement: the CDMO should declare that its process meets the regulatory requirements of the target markets listed by the client

blocks.zh: 未簽訂完善 Quality Agreement 即開始委外生產，是 FDA 483 觀察項和 EMA GMP 稽查最常見的缺失類型之一。
blocks.en: Starting outsourced manufacturing without a sound Quality Agreement is one of the most common types of deficiency in FDA 483 observations and EMA GMP inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Phase-Appropriate GMP
blocks.en: Analogy: Phase-Appropriate GMP

blocks.zh: Phase-appropriate GMP（分階段適用的 GMP）就像一個學生的成長歷程：
blocks.en: Phase-appropriate GMP is like a student's journey of growth:

blocks.zh: 臨床一期（Phase I）：就像剛升大學——老師對學生的報告格式相對寬鬆，但基本學術誠信（無菌性、安全性、身份確認）不能打折扣
blocks.en: Phase I clinical: like starting university. The teacher is relatively relaxed about the report format, but basic academic integrity (sterility, safety, identity confirmation) cannot be compromised

blocks.zh: 臨床二/三期（Phase II/III）：就像研究所——要求更嚴格的論文格式、更詳細的方法論（製程驗證、系統性管控）
blocks.en: Phase II/III clinical: like graduate school. A stricter thesis format and more detailed methodology are required (process validation, systematic controls)

blocks.zh: 上市後（Commercial）：就像進入職場——每份「報告」（批次）都必須符合最完整的專業標準，任何偏差都必須書面說明
blocks.en: Commercial: like entering the workforce. Every "report" (batch) must meet the most complete professional standard, and any deviation must be explained in writing

blocks.zh: 但注意：無論哪個階段，「真實性」（Identity）和「患者安全」（Safety）是不可妥協的底線，就像學術誠信貫穿整個求學生涯。
blocks.en: But note that at every phase, "Identity" and patient "Safety" are non-negotiable bottom lines, just as academic integrity runs through the whole of one's schooling.

blocks.zh: FDA CMC 指引要求 CDMO 提供 IND CMC 章節所需的文件。請列舉至少五種 CDMO 應在 Quality Agreement 中承諾提供的文件類型。
blocks.en: The FDA CMC guidance requires the CDMO to provide the documents needed for the IND CMC section. List at least five types of documents that a CDMO should commit to providing in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: 「外源性因子風險無法完全消除」對 CDMO 的品質系統設計有什麼具體意涵？請設計一個三層次的外源性因子防禦策略。
blocks.en: What specific implications does "the risk of adventitious agents cannot be completely eliminated" have for the design of a CDMO's quality system? Design a three-layer adventitious agent defense strategy.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Replication-Competent Virus（RCV）被視為基因治療中最嚴重的安全風險之一？請說明 RCV 的形成機制及其潛在的臨床後果。
blocks.en: Why is Replication-Competent Virus (RCV) regarded as one of the most serious safety risks in gene therapy? Explain the mechanism by which RCV forms and its potential clinical consequences.

blocks.zh: Q 1.5 — Special Considerations for Classification of Plasmids Q 1.5 — 質體分類之特殊考量
blocks.en: Q 1.5 - Special Considerations for Classification of Plasmids

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 多質體系統的複雜性
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Complexity of Multi-Plasmid Systems

blocks.zh: 理解為什麼 AAV 和慢病毒（Lentivirus）需要多個質體，需要先瞭解病毒載體的製造邏輯：
blocks.en: To understand why AAV and lentivirus need multiple plasmids, you first need to understand the logic of viral vector manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要 3 個以上質體？
blocks.en: Why are three or more plasmids needed?

blocks.zh: 如果把所有病毒基因都放在同一個質體中，共轉染後的宿主細胞可能自行組裝出具備複製能力的野生型病毒（RCV）——這是極大的安全危害。因此業界的做法是將關鍵基因「分拆」到三個以上的質體中：
blocks.en: If all the viral genes were placed on a single plasmid, the host cell after co-transfection could assemble replication-competent wild-type virus (RCV) on its own, which is an extremely serious safety hazard. The industry practice is therefore to "split" the key genes across three or more plasmids:

blocks.zh: 轉殖基因質體（Transfer Plasmid）：攜帶目標治療基因（transgene）及其調控元件（啟動子等）
blocks.en: Transfer Plasmid: carries the therapeutic gene of interest (the transgene) and its regulatory elements (promoter, etc.)

blocks.zh: 包膜質體（Envelope Plasmid）：編碼病毒外膜蛋白（決定載體的組織趨向性，即靶向哪種細胞）
blocks.en: Envelope Plasmid: encodes the viral envelope protein (which determines the tissue tropism of the vector, that is, which cells it targets)

blocks.zh: 包裝質體（Packaging Plasmid）：編碼病毒結構蛋白和複製所需的酶，但缺少包裝訊號，無法獨立形成感染性病毒
blocks.en: Packaging Plasmid: encodes the viral structural proteins and the enzymes required for replication, but lacks the packaging signal and so cannot form infectious virus on its own

blocks.zh: 只有當所有質體同時存在於宿主細胞中，才能組裝出病毒載體；任何單一質體都無法形成感染性病毒，從而降低 RCV 的形成風險。
blocks.en: Only when all of the plasmids are present in the host cell at the same time can a viral vector be assembled; no single plasmid can form infectious virus, which lowers the risk of RCV formation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CDMO 質體交叉污染：已有真實臨床擱置案例
blocks.en: Key Point: Plasmid Cross-Contamination at CDMOs, Where Real Clinical Holds Have Occurred

blocks.zh: PtC-11 明確指出：「臨床試驗已因使用受污染的研究等級質體生產臨床材料而被暫停」。
blocks.en: PtC-11 states explicitly: "clinical trials have been put on hold because of the use of contaminated research-grade plasmid to produce clinical material."

blocks.zh: 這不是假設性風險，而是已發生的真實事件。典型的交叉污染發生場景：
blocks.en: This is not a hypothetical risk but an event that has actually happened. Typical scenarios in which cross-contamination occurs:

blocks.zh: 共用設備：CDMO 的發酵槽、管路、過濾系統用於多個客戶的質體生產，清潔不徹底導致上一批次質體攜帶至下一批次
blocks.en: Shared equipment: a CDMO's fermenters, piping, and filtration systems are used for the plasmid production of several clients, and inadequate cleaning carries plasmid from the previous batch over to the next

blocks.zh: 共用耗材：試劑、緩衝液、填充料可能在不同批次間交叉使用
blocks.en: Shared consumables: reagents, buffers, and resins may be cross-used between different batches

blocks.zh: 人員流動：操作員在不同產品間流動，可能攜帶微量污染物
blocks.en: Personnel movement: operators moving between different products may carry trace contaminants

blocks.zh: 換產不充分：清潔驗證不嚴謹，無法保證完全去除前一批次殘留質體
blocks.en: Inadequate changeover: rigor in cleaning validation is insufficient, so complete removal of residual plasmid from the previous batch cannot be assured

blocks.zh: 對患者的潛在影響極為嚴重：若另一客戶的質體混入，患者可能接受到含有未知基因元件的製品，導致無法預測的基因表現或免疫反應。
blocks.en: The potential impact on patients is extremely serious: if another client's plasmid gets mixed in, the patient may receive a product containing unknown genetic elements, leading to unpredictable gene expression or immune reactions.

blocks.zh: FDA 的期望（FDA Neurodegenerative Disease Gene Therapy Guidance）：多產品設施生產的質體，必須測試是否含有共純化的其他污染質體。這項要求在實務上極具挑戰性，因為 CDMO 通常不會透露其他客戶的質體序列資訊。
blocks.en: FDA expectations (FDA Neurodegenerative Disease Gene Therapy Guidance): plasmids produced in multi-product facilities must be tested for co-purified contaminating plasmids. This requirement is very challenging in practice, because a CDMO normally does not disclose the plasmid sequence information of its other clients.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 質體身份確認的定序策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: Sequencing Strategy for Plasmid Identity Confirmation

blocks.zh: PtC-11 建議 ATMP 製造商在接收 CDMO 供應的質體或病毒載體時，定期進行序列定序，以支持整體身份管控策略。以下是可行的定序策略框架：
blocks.en: PtC-11 recommends that ATMP manufacturers periodically perform sequencing when receiving plasmids or viral vectors supplied by a CDMO, to support the overall identity control strategy. A feasible sequencing strategy framework is as follows:

blocks.zh: 每批次接收時（Receipt Testing）：
blocks.en: At receipt of each batch (Receipt Testing):

blocks.zh: 限制酶切分析（Restriction Enzyme Digest，RED）：快速確認質體構型是否一致，成本低，可作為常規批次放行測試
blocks.en: Restriction Enzyme Digest (RED): quickly confirms that the plasmid configuration is consistent; low cost, and can serve as a routine batch release test

blocks.zh: 關鍵區域定序（Partial Sequencing）：針對啟動子、轉殖基因編碼序列、調控元件等關鍵區域進行 Sanger 定序，確認無突變
blocks.en: Partial Sequencing of key regions: Sanger sequencing of key regions such as the promoter, the transgene coding sequence, and regulatory elements to confirm there are no mutations

blocks.zh: 定期全長定序（Periodic Full-Length Sequencing）：
blocks.en: Periodic Full-Length Sequencing:

blocks.zh: 採用 Next-Generation Sequencing（NGS）進行全質體定序，頻率建議每季度或每 N 批次一次
blocks.en: Use Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) for whole-plasmid sequencing, with a recommended frequency of once per quarter or once every N batches

blocks.zh: NGS 可同時檢測：序列突變、插入/缺失、混雜序列（即交叉污染的外源 DNA）
blocks.en: NGS can detect at the same time: sequence mutations, insertions/deletions, and mixed sequences (that is, foreign DNA from cross-contamination)

blocks.zh: 建立質體參考序列資料庫（Reference Database），以每次定序結果與之比對
blocks.en: Build a plasmid Reference Database, and compare each sequencing result against it

blocks.zh: 換產後首批增強測試：
blocks.en: Enhanced testing for the first batch after changeover:

blocks.zh: CDMO 換產後第一批質體，要求全長 NGS 作為常規批次放行的額外條件
blocks.en: For the first plasmid batch after a CDMO changeover, require full-length NGS as an additional condition for routine batch release

blocks.zh: 要求 CDMO 提供換產清潔驗證報告（Cleaning Validation Report）
blocks.en: Require the CDMO to provide the changeover Cleaning Validation Report

blocks.zh: Quality Agreement 條款支撐：
blocks.en: Supporting Quality Agreement clauses:

blocks.zh: 明確要求 CDMO 揭露其在同一設施生產的其他產品的類別（無需揭露客戶身份，但須揭露病毒類型，以評估交叉污染風險）
blocks.en: Explicitly require the CDMO to disclose the categories of other products manufactured in the same facility (the identity of the clients need not be disclosed, but the virus type must be, so that the cross-contamination risk can be assessed)

blocks.zh: 要求 CDMO 的換產程序在稽核中可審閱
blocks.en: Require that the CDMO's changeover procedures be available for review during audits

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 質體 DNA 的序列完整性
blocks.en: Analogy: The Sequence Integrity of Plasmid DNA

blocks.zh: 把質體 DNA 想像成一份精確的樂譜。基因治療的「表演」（病毒載體組裝、基因表現）完全依賴這份樂譜的準確性：
blocks.en: Think of plasmid DNA as a precise musical score. The "performance" of gene therapy (viral vector assembly, gene expression) depends entirely on the accuracy of this score:

blocks.zh: 一個音符的錯誤（單鹼基突變）可能讓整首曲子走調（蛋白質功能喪失）
blocks.en: A single wrong note (a single-base mutation) can throw the whole piece out of tune (loss of protein function)

blocks.zh: 一小節被刪除（序列缺失）可能讓演出中途崩潰（治療失效）
blocks.en: A deleted bar (a sequence deletion) can make the performance collapse midway (treatment failure)

blocks.zh: 混入另一位作曲家的段落（交叉污染）可能讓觀眾聽到完全無法預測的音樂（患者接受非預期基因表現）
blocks.en: Passages mixed in from another composer (cross-contamination) can make the audience hear music that is completely unpredictable (the patient receives unintended gene expression)

blocks.zh: 定序（Sequencing）就是演出前仔細校對每一頁樂譜，確認每個音符都正確無誤。對於基因治療而言，「校對樂譜」不是可選項，而是患者安全的基本保障。
blocks.en: Sequencing is carefully proofreading every page of the score before the performance, confirming that every note is correct. For gene therapy, "proofreading the score" is not optional but a basic safeguard of patient safety.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 AAV 和慢病毒載體的生產需要使用三個以上的質體？這種設計如何降低 RCV 的形成風險？
blocks.en: Why does the production of AAV and lentiviral vectors require three or more plasmids? How does this design lower the risk of RCV formation?

blocks.zh: FDA 要求多產品設施的質體必須測試污染質體的存在，但 CDMO 不願意提供其他客戶的質體序列資訊。請設計一個不依賴他方序列資訊的質體身份確認策略。
blocks.en: The FDA requires plasmids from multi-product facilities to be tested for the presence of contaminating plasmids, but the CDMO is unwilling to provide the plasmid sequence information of its other clients. Design a plasmid identity confirmation strategy that does not depend on other parties' sequence information.

blocks.zh: 若一個批次的慢病毒載體（lentiviral vector）在接收定序時發現含有少量未知 DNA 片段，CDMO 的品質系統應如何應對？請描述異常調查（OOS investigation）的步驟。
blocks.en: If a batch of lentiviral vector is found at receipt sequencing to contain a small amount of unknown DNA fragments, how should the CDMO's quality system respond? Describe the steps of the OOS investigation.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 分類框架無統一標準：相同的病毒載體在 FDA（藥物物質）、EMA（關鍵起始物料）、澳洲 TGA（視使用方式而異）有完全不同的分類，每種分類對應不同的 GMP 要求。CDMO 必須以最嚴格市場的要求作為基準線。
blocks.en: No uniform classification standard: the same viral vector is classified completely differently by the FDA (drug substance), the EMA (critical starting material), and the Australian TGA (depends on how it is used), and each classification corresponds to different GMP requirements. A CDMO must use the requirements of the strictest market as its baseline.

blocks.zh: 六大核心指引文件：FDA Gene Therapy CMC IND Guidance 和 EMA/CAT/80183/2014 是主要參考，PIC/S Annex 2A Sections 5.20–5.29 是多轄區策略的最佳工具，EMA Q&A (EMA/246400/2021) 提供起始物料風險評估的七大因素框架。
blocks.en: Six core guidance documents: the FDA Gene Therapy CMC IND Guidance and EMA/CAT/80183/2014 are the main references, PIC/S Annex 2A Sections 5.20–5.29 is the best tool for a multi-jurisdiction strategy, and the EMA Q&A (EMA/246400/2021) provides the seven-factor framework for starting material risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 三類基因治療產品分類原則：in vivo mRNA/DNA → DS 為 mRNA/DNA；in vivo 病毒載體 → DS 為病毒載體；ex vivo 細胞修飾（CAR-T）→ FDA 視載體為 DS，EMA 視修飾細胞為唯一 DS，載體降格為關鍵起始物料。雙市場策略：始終將載體視為 DS 製造。
blocks.en: Classification principles for the three types of gene therapy products: in vivo mRNA/DNA → the DS is the mRNA/DNA; in vivo viral vector → the DS is the viral vector; ex vivo cell modification (CAR-T) → the FDA regards the vector as a DS, while the EMA regards the modified cells as the only DS and downgrades the vector to a critical starting material. Dual-market strategy: always manufacture the vector as a DS.

blocks.zh: 外源性因子風險無法完全消除：病毒載體因其生物性質，無法終端滅菌，外源性病毒（adventitious agents）、TSE 和 RCV 風險需透過多層次管控策略應對，Quality Agreement 是委外生產中界定雙方責任的法規要求文件。
blocks.en: The risk of adventitious agents cannot be completely eliminated: because of their biological nature, viral vectors cannot be terminally sterilized, and the risks of adventitious viruses (adventitious agents), TSE, and RCV must be addressed through a multi-layered control strategy; the Quality Agreement is the regulatory-required document that defines the responsibilities of both parties in outsourced manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 質體 DNA 的特殊挑戰：序列完整性（每個鹼基都必須正確）、多質體系統的複雜性、以及 CDMO 多產品設施的交叉污染風險（已有真實臨床擱置案例）。有效的管控策略包括批次接收定序、定期 NGS 全長定序、以及在 Quality Agreement 中要求 CDMO 揭露換產程序。
blocks.en: Special challenges of plasmid DNA: sequence integrity (every base must be correct), the complexity of multi-plasmid systems, and the risk of cross-contamination in multi-product CDMO facilities (real clinical hold cases have occurred). Effective control strategies include sequencing at batch receipt, periodic full-length NGS sequencing, and requiring the CDMO to disclose its changeover procedures in the Quality Agreement.
